gaps.detail: Physical one hundred one and one hundred five were locally rendered and inspected. Hand-signal facts use original verbal descriptions; turning-lane facts rely on explicit prose. No diagram is reproduced or visual-recognition clearance asserted.

General solid-line guidance must be read with bicycle-lane turning and vulnerable-road-user passing exceptions from their own source pages. The double-yellow passing prohibition is stated for passing another vehicle and is not expanded into a ban on every permitted center-line crossing. Crosswalk rules do not grant permission to pass a vehicle yielding to a pedestrian.
